title: The Menu, Week 5
dek: Puka Nacua climbs to WR2, Braelon Allen and David Montgomery move into the RB2 range, and Kyle Monangai slides to RB28 after two missed practices.
author: Chef Hazy
intro_md:
Updated Fri 5:45 PM ET with the injury report: Lamar Jackson and Kyle Monangai are out, so D'Andre Swift moves up to RB11 with the Chicago backfield to himself. Ashton Jeanty (questionable, no practice Friday) slides to RB18, Alvin Kamara to RB26 and Rhamondre Stevenson to RB24. Zay Flowers is questionable with Tyler Huntley starting and drops to WR12. Stefon Diggs and Quentin Johnston are out, so Antonio Williams climbs to WR44 and Tre' Harris to WR35. Chris Olave, Jayden Daniels and Tyler Shough have no designation.

Updated Fri 10:45 AM ET: the order is refreshed. Puka Nacua climbs to WR2, Garrett Wilson to WR9 and Davante Adams to WR10. Braelon Allen is RB16 and David Montgomery RB22, while Kyle Monangai slides to RB28 after missing two practices with the toe and Omarion Hampton drops to RB27. Justin Jefferson is back at WR17. Isaiah Likely is TE6 and Harold Fannin Jr. TE8. Ja'Marr Chase, DJ Moore and Ladd McConkey are off the Menu.

Updated Thu 10:20 PM ET: Michael Pittman Jr. is out multiple weeks with the foot, which leaves DK Metcalf as Pittsburgh's outside passing game; Metcalf is WR18 for me, a WR2. Colston Loveland drew a team-high 9 targets from Tyson Bagent in Week 4 and is TE8 for me @GB.

Updated Wed 11:15 AM ET: the order is refreshed. Jared Goff moves up to QB2, Matthew Stafford to QB4 and Jacoby Brissett to QB8. Michael Wilson jumps to WR8, Jaxon Smith-Njigba is WR1 and CeeDee Lamb is WR5. Kyren Williams is RB4 and Jaylen Warren RB8. Lamar Jackson and Saquon Barkley fall off the Menu as doubtful, and DeVonta Smith, Breece Hall and Rico Dowdle are off.

Week 5 brings the first byes: Kansas City and Carolina are off, so Patrick Mahomes, Kenneth Walker III, Travis Kelce, Bryce Young, Chuba Hubbard and Tetairoa McMillan are not on the Menu. Tampa Bay at Dallas opens Thursday, Philadelphia and Jacksonville play at 9:30 AM ET in London, and Buffalo closes Monday night at the Rams. Rankings are for full PPR.

The injury list does the most moving. Ja'Marr Chase (concussion), DJ Moore (shoulder) and Ladd McConkey (foot) are off the Menu. That opens the door for Braelon Allen (RB16) with Breece Hall hurt, Emanuel Wilson (RB17) with Zach Charbonnet ruled out, Will Shipley (RB23) in London, and Dohnte Meyers and Keon Coleman at receiver. Kyle Monangai ran 30 times for 146 after D'Andre Swift's fumble but missed two practices with the toe and sits at RB28. CeeDee Lamb drew 21 of Dak Prescott's 45 throws at HOU.

Prep Notes revisits every injury Friday after the final report and updates this page, with Chris Olave, Ashton Jeanty, Kyle Monangai and Zay Flowers first in line.
outro_md: Tiers are courses. The top of a tier is the safest plate; the bottom is where the injuries live. A questionable or doubtful player keeps his action until Friday's report decides it. Specials are matchup plays outside the top tiers.
